verses.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.pt: Estas são as palavras que Moisés falou a todo Israel além do Jordão, no deserto, na Arabá defronte de Sufe, entre Parã, Tofel, Labã, Hazerote e Di-Zaabe.
verses.en_web: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah over against Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.en_bbe: These are the words which Moses said to all Israel on the far side of Jordan, in the waste land in the Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran on the one side, and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab on the other.

verses.en: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
verses.pt: São onze dias de viagem desde Horebe, pelo caminho da montanha de Seir, até Cades-Barnéia.
verses.en_web: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.en_bbe: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.pt: No ano quadragésimo, no mês undécimo, no primeiro dia do mês, Moisés falou aos filhos de Israel, conforme tudo o que o senhor lhes mandara por seu intermédio,
verses.en_web: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that Yahweh had given him in commandment to them;
verses.en_bbe: Now in the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses gave to the children of Israel all the orders which the Lord had given him for them;

verses.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.pt: depois que derrotou a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, que habitava em Astarote, em Edrei.
verses.en_web: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.
verses.en_bbe: After he had overcome Sihon, king of the Amorites, ruling in Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, ruling in Ashtaroth, at Edrei:

verses.en: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.pt: Além do Jordão, na terra de Moabe, Moisés se pôs a explicar esta lei, e disse:
verses.en_web: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,
verses.en_bbe: On the far side of Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses gave the people this law, saying,

verses.en: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.pt: O Senhor nosso Deus nos falou em Horebe, dizendo: Assaz vos haveis demorado neste monte.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord our God said to us in Horeb, You have been long enough in this mountain:

verses.en: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.pt: Voltai-vos, ponde-vos a caminho, e ide à região montanhosa dos amorreus, e a todos os lugares vizinhos, na Arabá, na região montanhosa, no vale e no sul; à beira do mar, à terra dos cananeus, e ao Líbano, até o grande rio, o rio Eufrates.
verses.en_web: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites, and to all the places near there, in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.en_bbe: Make a move now, and go on your way into the hill-country of the Amorites and the places near it, in the Arabah and the hill-country and in the lowlands and in the South and by the seaside, all the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.en: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.pt: Eis que tenho posto esta terra diante de vós; entrai e possuí a terra que o Senhor prometeu com juramento dar a vossos pais, Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, a eles e à sua descendência depois deles.
verses.en_web: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”
verses.en_bbe: See, all the land is before you: go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their seed after them.

verses.en: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.pt: Nesse mesmo tempo eu vos disse: Eu sozinho não posso levar-vos,
verses.en_web: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.
verses.en_bbe: At that time I said to you, I am not able to undertake the care of you by myself;

verses.en: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.pt: o Senhor vosso Deus já vos tem multiplicado, e eis que hoje sois tão numerosos como as estrelas do céu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord your God has given you increase, and now you are like the stars of heaven in number.

verses.en: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.pt: O Senhor Deus de vossos pais vos faça mil vezes mais numerosos do que sois; e vos abençoe, como vos prometeu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times greater in number than you are, and give you his blessing as he has said!

verses.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.pt: Como posso eu sozinho suportar o vosso peso, as vossas cargas e as vossas contendas?
verses.en_web: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?
verses.en_bbe: How is it possible for me by myself to be responsible for you, and undertake the weight of all your troubles and your arguments?

verses.en: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.pt: Tomai-vos homens sábios, entendidos e experimentados, segundo as vossas tribos, e eu os porei como cabeças sobre vós.
verses.en_web: Take wise men of understanding and well known according to your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
verses.en_bbe: Take for yourselves men who are wise, far-seeing, and respected among you, from your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

verses.en: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.pt: Então me respondestes: bom fazermos o que disseste.
verses.en_web: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”
verses.en_bbe: And you made answer and said to me, It is good for us to do as you say.

verses.en: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.pt: Tomei, pois, os cabeças de vossas tribos, homens sábios e experimentados, e os constituí por cabeças sobre vós, chefes de mil, chefes de cem, chefes de cinqüenta e chefes de dez, por oficiais, segundo as vossas tribos.
verses.en_web: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, and captains of fifties, and captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.
verses.en_bbe: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men and respected, and made them rulers over you, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds and captains of fifties and captains of tens, and overseers of your tribes.

verses.en: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.pt: E no mesmo tempo ordenei a vossos juízes, dizendo: Ouvi as causas entre vossos irmãos, e julgai com justiça entre o homem e seu irmão, ou o estrangeiro que está com ele.
verses.en_web: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.
verses.en_bbe: And at that time I gave orders to your judges, saying, Let all questions between your brothers come before you for hearing, and give decisions uprightly between a man and his brother or one from another nation who is with him.

verses.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.pt: Não fareis acepção de pessoas em juízo; de um mesmo modo ouvireis o pequeno e o grande; não temereis a face de ninguém, porque o juízo é de Deus; e a causa que vos for difícil demais, a trareis a mim, e eu a ouvirei.
verses.en_web: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”
verses.en_bbe: In judging, do not let a man's position have any weight with you; give hearing equally to small and great; have no fear of any man, for it is God who is judge: and any cause in which you are not able to give a decision, you are to put before me and I will give it a hearing.

verses.en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.pt: Assim naquele tempo vos ordenei todas as coisas que devíeis fazer.
verses.en_web: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.en_bbe: And at that time I gave you all the orders which you were to do.

verses.en: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.pt: Então partimos de Horebe, e caminhamos por todo aquele grande e terrível deserto que vistes, pelo caminho das montanhas dos amorreus, como o Senhor nosso Deus nos ordenara; e chegamos a Cades-Barnéia.
verses.en_web: We traveled from Horeb, and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as Yahweh our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
verses.en_bbe: Then we went on from Horeb, through all that great and cruel waste which you saw, on our way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as the Lord gave us orders; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.en: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.pt: Então eu vos disse: Chegados sois às montanhas dos amorreus, que o Senhor nosso Deus nos dá.
verses.en_web: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which Yahweh our God gives to us.
verses.en_bbe: And I said to you, You have come to the hill-country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.

verses.en: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.pt: Eis aqui o Senhor teu Deus tem posto esta terra diante de ti; sobe, apodera-te dela, como te falou o Senhor Deus de teus pais; não temas, e não te assustes.
verses.en_web: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
verses.en_bbe: See now, the Lord your God has put the land into your hands: go up and take it, as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has said to you; have no fear and do not be troubled.

verses.en: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.pt: Então todos vós vos chegastes a mim, e dissestes: Mandemos homens adiante de nós, para que nos espiem a terra e, de volta, nos ensinem o caminho pelo qual devemos subir, e as cidades a que devemos ir.
verses.en_web: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let us send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”
verses.en_bbe: And you came near to me, every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us to go through the land with care and give us an account of the way we are to go and the towns to which we will come.

verses.en: and the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.pt: Isto me pareceu bem; de modo que dentre vós tomei doze homens, de cada tribo um homem;
verses.en_web: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve men of you, one man for every tribe.
verses.en_bbe: And what you said seemed good to me, and I took twelve men from among you, one from every tribe;

verses.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.pt: foram-se eles e, subindo as montanhas, chegaram até o vale de Escol e espiaram a terra.
verses.en_web: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.
verses.en_bbe: And they went up into the hill-country and came to the valley of Eshcol, and saw what was there.

verses.en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.pt: Tomaram do fruto da terra nas mãos, e no-lo trouxeram; e nos informaram, dizendo: Boa é a terra que nos dá o Senhor nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which Yahweh our God gives to us.”
verses.en_bbe: And taking in their hands some of the fruit of the land, they came down again to us, and gave us their account, saying, It is a good land which the Lord our God is giving us.

verses.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.pt: Todavia, vós não quisestes subir, mas fostes rebeldes ao mandado do Senhor nosso Deus;
verses.en_web: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: But going against the order of the Lord your God, you would not go up:

verses.en: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.pt: e murmurastes nas vossas tendas, e dissestes: Porquanto o Senhor nos odeia, tirou-nos da terra do Egito para nos entregar nas mãos dos amorreus, a fim de nos destruir.
verses.en_web: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because Yahweh hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.en_bbe: And you made an angry outcry in your tents, and said, In his hate for us the Lord has taken us out of the land of Egypt, to give us up into the hands of the Amorites for our destruction.

verses.en: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.pt: Para onde estamos nós subindo? nossos irmãos fizeram com que se derretesse o nosso coração, dizendo: Maior e mais alto é o povo do que nós; as cidades são grandes e fortificadas até o céu; e também vimos ali os filhos dos anaquins.
verses.en_web: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”
verses.en_bbe: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our hearts feeble with fear by saying, The people are greater and taller than we are, and the towns are great and walled up to heaven; and more than this, we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.

verses.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.pt: Então eu vos disse: Não vos atemorizeis, e não tenhais medo deles.
verses.en_web: Then I said to you, “Don’t dread, neither be afraid of them.
verses.en_bbe: Then I said to you, Have no fear of them.

verses.en: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.pt: O Senhor vosso Deus, que vai adiante de vós, ele pelejará por vós, conforme tudo o que tem feito por vós diante dos vossos olhos, no Egito,
verses.en_web: Yahweh your God who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,
verses.en_bbe: The Lord your God who goes before you will be fighting for you, and will do such wonders as he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

verses.en: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.pt: como também no deserto, onde vistes como o Senhor vosso Deus vos levou, como um homem leva seu filho, por todo o caminho que andastes, até chegardes a este lugar.
verses.en_web: and in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahweh your God bore you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the waste land, where you have seen how the Lord was supporting you, as a man does his son, in all your journeying till you came to this place.

verses.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
verses.pt: Mas nem ainda assim confiastes no Senhor vosso Deus,
verses.en_web: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe Yahweh your God,
verses.en_bbe: But for all this, you had no faith in the Lord your God,

verses.en: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.pt: que ia adiante de vós no caminho, de noite no fogo e de dia na nuvem, para vos achar o lugar onde devíeis acampar, e para vos mostrar o caminho por onde havíeis de andar.
verses.en_web: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.en_bbe: Who goes before you on your way, looking for a place where you may put up your tents, in fire by night, lighting up the way you are to go, and in a cloud by day.

verses.en: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.pt: Ouvindo, pois, o Senhor a voz das vossas palavras, indignou-se e jurou, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, and was angry, and swore, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord, hearing your words, was angry, and said with an oath,

verses.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.pt: Nenhum dos homens desta geração perversa verá a boa terra que prometi com juramento dar a vossos pais,
verses.en_web: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land, which I swore to give to your fathers,
verses.en_bbe: Truly, not one of this evil generation will see that good land which I said I would give to your fathers,

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
verses.pt: salvo Calebe, filho de Jefoné; ele a verá, e a terra que pisou darei a ele e a seus filhos, porquanto perseverou em seguir ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he will see it; and to him and to his children I will give the land over which his feet have gone, because he has been true to the Lord with all his heart.

verses.en: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.pt: Também contra mim o Senhor se indignou por vossa causa, dizendo: Igualmente tu lá não entrarás.
verses.en_web: Also Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.
verses.en_bbe: And, in addition, the Lord was angry with me because of you, saying, You yourself will not go into it:

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.pt: Josué, filho de Num, que te serve, ele ali entrará; anima-o, porque ele fará que Israel a receba por herança.
verses.en_web: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.en_bbe: Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, he will go into the land: say to him that he is to be strong, for he will be Israel's guide into their heritage.

verses.en: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.pt: E vossos pequeninos, dos quais dissestes que seriam por presa, e vossos filhos que hoje não conhecem nem o bem nem o mal, esses lá entrarão, a eles a darei e eles a possuirão.
verses.en_web: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, and your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.
verses.en_bbe: And your little ones, who, you said, would come into strange hands, your children, who now have no knowledge of good or evil, they will go into that land, and to them I will give it and it will be theirs.

verses.en: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.pt: Quanto a vós, porém, virai-vos, e parti para o deserto, pelo caminho do Mar Vermelho.
verses.en_web: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
verses.en_bbe: But as for you, go back, journeying into the waste land by the way of the Red Sea.

verses.en: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.pt: Então respondestes, e me dissestes: Pecamos contra o Senhor; nós subiremos e pelejaremos, conforme tudo o que nos ordenou o Senhor nosso Deus. Vós, pois, vos armastes, cada um, dos vossos instrumentos de guerra, e temerariamente propusestes subir a montanha.
verses.en_web: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against Yahweh, we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahweh our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.
verses.en_bbe: Then you said to me, We have done evil against the Lord, we will go up to the attack, as the Lord our God has given us orders. And arming yourselves every one, you made ready to go up without care into the hill-country.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.pt: E disse-me o Senhor: Dize-lhes: Não subais nem pelejeis, pois não estou no meio de vós; para que não sejais feridos diante de vossos inimigos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you; lest you be struck before your enemies.’”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to me, Say to them, Do not go up to the attack; for I am not among you, and you will be overcome by those who are against you.

verses.en: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.pt: Assim vos falei, mas não ouvistes; antes fostes rebeldes à ordem do Senhor e, agindo presunçosamente, subistes à montanha.
verses.en_web: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.
verses.en_bbe: This I said to you, but you gave no attention and went against the orders of the Lord, and in your pride went up into the hill-country.

verses.en: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.pt: E os amorreus, que habitavam naquela montanha, vos saíram ao encontro e, perseguindo-vos como fazem as abelhas, vos destroçaram desde Seir até Horma.
verses.en_web: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.
verses.en_bbe: And the Amorites who were in the hill-country came out against you and put you to flight, rushing after you like bees, and overcame you in Seir, driving you even as far as Hormah.

verses.en: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.pt: Voltastes, pois, e chorastes perante o Senhor; mas o Senhor não ouviu a vossa voz, nem para vós inclinou os ouvidos.
verses.en_web: You returned and wept before Yahweh; but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
verses.en_bbe: And you came back, weeping before the Lord; but the Lord gave no attention to your cries and did not give ear to you.

verses.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.pt: Assim foi grande a vossa demora em Cades, pois ali vos demorastes muitos dias.
verses.en_web: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.
verses.en_bbe: So you were kept waiting in Kadesh for a long time.
